#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = image ] && [ "$2" = inspect ]; then
  case "$3" in img:ok|sha256:1111111111111111111111111111) cat fx/inspect.json; exit 0;;
  img:other) cat fx/other.json; exit 0;; img:junk) echo junk; exit 0;; img:empty) echo '[]'; exit 0;; esac
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$1" = history ]; then
  case "$5" in img:ok|sha256:1111111111111111111111111111) printf 'RUN |2 VLLM_REF=abc FOO=1 /bin/sh -c x\n|1 VLLM_REF=def /bin/sh\n|1 NGC_URL=x\n'; exit 0;; esac
  exit 1
fi
exit 9
